scope: Development selection on existing calibration only; old holdout input images used for diagnosis, never variant selection

candidate_policies.margin_definition: Top identity score minus second distinct identity score; a positive margin requires a second identity
candidate_policies.selection_order: Among policies meeting all calibration targets: maximize known correct confirmations, minimize unknown/no-cat false accepts, minimize known wrong confirmations, prefer zero margin, then higher confirmed threshold, then higher margin
candidate_policies.no_feasible_policy: Report calibration targets unmet; do not open holdout or change defaults

variants.letterbox: YOLO crop, aspect-preserving longest-side224 (round, minimum1), RGB(124,116,104) centered padding, same ImageNet normalization and model

selection_rule: Apply existing frozen policy-grid selection order. Among variant ties prefer variant_order. Advance only if selected calibration candidate improves (known correct confirmations, then unknown+no-cat false accepts, then known wrong confirmations) over feasible center-2 baseline. Threshold-only tie changes are not improvement.
stop_rule: If no improvement, retain baseline and report failure; do not spend a fresh holdout on an unimproved candidate. No extra variants or seeds after results.
next_stage: For an improved candidate, implement compatible versioned pipeline; independently sample new calibration and new holdout identities excluding all prior/inspected identities. Freeze protocol and then selected policy before one holdout run.
limitations: Model training overlap unknown; provider did not publish its 131-cat training manifest
Cat identities are source labels, not owner-verified identities
AFHQ dog photos lack individual identity/session metadata; image-disjoint partitions may still contain correlated subjects
Dog negatives do not cover toys, screens, multiple cats or production upload distributions
Changing gallery size, model or image domain requires fresh calibration and validation
